## Open

### T-600 — The blong namespace has no process or path in the suite

> _2026-11-02 · suite/blong-suite · open_

The `blong` namespace has no process and no ingress path in this suite, so its pages are drawn but
unserved. The browser bundle carries the realm (the Observe menu comes from it), the plan's realms
are `core`, `access`, `marine` and `login`, and the generator writes `/rpc/<deployment>` only for a
deployment named after its namespace; `POST /rpc/blong/flow/find` through the portal host therefore
falls to `/`, reaches the portal's pod and answers `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9455`. Decide
which way: give the realm a process and a path (`blong: {}` in the `k8s`, `upgrade` and `release`
realm lists, which adds a fifth pod), or drop the Observe pages from this suite's menu. Verify with
the proxy: `blong-dev proxy --port 8097 --target https://marine.feasible.one` then
`POST /blong/flow/find`.
